chunks: And it is narrated from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ, from Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man died while fasting was due from him; should fasting be performed on his behalf, or should charity be given? He said: Charity should be given on his behalf, for it is better.

key_terms.صَوْمٌ: sawm (fasting) owed as a religious obligation
key_terms.يُتَصَدَّقُ: to give charity on someone's behalf
key_terms.يُصَامُ: to have fasting performed on someone's behalf

ai.seo_question: If a person dies owing fasting, should one fast on his behalf or give charity instead?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased person who still had an outstanding obligation of sawm (fasting). Imam Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام states that giving charity on his behalf is better in this case.
